# Twitter Data Scraper - Tweet Logger

This project allows users to scrape Twitter for tweets mentioning specific topics, logging the results in a structured format. It’s a simple yet powerful solution for extracting valuable social media insights.

## Introduction

This scraper helps you gather tweets based on a specified topic, saving each tweet's key details like content, time, and user info. It's ideal for anyone needing to track mentions of specific keywords or topics on Twitter.

### Why Scraping Twitter Matters for Social Media Insights

- Collect real-time insights for research or brand monitoring.
- Monitor trending topics or hashtags automatically.
- Gather large volumes of data for sentiment analysis or market research.
- Track mentions of your products or competitors.
- Automate data entry tasks to save time and reduce errors.

## Features

| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| Tweet Logging | Logs every tweet mentioning a specific topic, including the tweet's content, timestamp, and user info. |
| Real-Time Scraping | Continuously monitors Twitter for new tweets on the selected topics. |
| Easy Output Format | Saves data in an Excel-compatible format for easy analysis and reporting. |

---

| Field Name   | Field Description                       |
|--------------|-----------------------------------------|
| tweetText    | The content of the tweet.               |
| username     | The Twitter handle of the user posting the tweet. |
| tweetTime    | The time when the tweet was posted.     |
| tweetId      | A unique identifier for the tweet.      |
| retweets     | The number of retweets for the tweet.   |
| likes        | The number of likes for the tweet.      |
